decisions.reason: The claimed reverse implication in step 3.1 is false: v0 tensor v1 has total weight zero but not the opposite specified factor weights. This is nonfatal to (d), since the direct-sum grading in step 2.4 already gives weight compatibility. Replaced it with known-factor weight addition and the disjoint union over all pairs summing to mu; the Statement is unchanged. Coproduct local nilpotence, finite-cone counting, free tensor embedding and quotient inverses were checked.

Confirmed fatal logic defect in the Definition: at the bottom b of a two-vertex i-string, F(b)={b} but e_i b is outside F(b), so unrestricted F(b) is not a subcrystal. Renamed it a lowering-generated set, retained its exact formula and highest-weight condition B=F(b), and specified closure under nonzero images for F and C. The three direct item consumers establish raising-closed canonical components separately; none needs a statement repair.

Confirmed nonfatal wording defect: F5 and step 4.1 say that the isolated weight-zero vertex is fixed, whereas both operators send it to the zero sentinel. Replaced both phrases by killed and cited the general rank-one string theorem in F5. The four operator pairs, max formulas, B(2) and B(0) identification, and direct module decomposition with determinant 1+q_1^2 were checked; the Example and all Statement/Definition sections remain unchanged.

Confirmed nonfatal citation defect: F3 supplies crystal data, not module universality. The full source example already proves the standard-module construction and the existing lattice supplier cites universality, so the mathematics is recoverable without a new lemma. The repair verifies all A2 relations locally, cites the presentation and highest-weight universality theorem directly, constructs the canonical three-vector lattice and checks the antipode dual-basis rescaling. All three dual computations are valid without AC; the Example and Statement/Definition sections are unchanged.

repair_notes.conventions: A2 has q_1=q_2. W has coroot labels (0,1), (1,-1), (-1,0); its commutators are diag(0,1,-1) and diag(1,-1,0), and squares and alternating triples vanish. In the contragredient standard dual, F_i has coefficient -q_1 and E_i coefficient -q_1^{-1}; w1=u3*, w2=-q_1u2*, w3=q_1^2u1* normalize the two strings. F1/F3/F6/F7/F8 support Verification 1.2; no general decomposition theorem is used.
